messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system Sat 6 Sep
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system (FileSite) will be unavailable this Saturday 6 September from 07:00 to 13:00 for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any open documents before Friday evening. Email will be unaffected. Contact the helpdesk on x2200 with any questions.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
